items.summary: Recommendation: approve containment-only execution. Continue existing measurement and attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded legal/security evidence work. Do not create or queue new production work, requeue failures, add telemetry or dependencies, change configuration, spend, expand monetization, conduct external outreach, or adopt external components. Preserve failed-work isolation until lineage, ownership, root cause, focused validation, rollback, deduplication, and explicit disposition are documented. Keep private launch gates unchanged pending rights, privacy, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner decisions.

The candidate plan is technically feasible as a containment disposition. No new queue item is safe to enter this cycle because the authoritative candidate list is empty, failure repair and measurement capacity are occupied, and required isolation, validation, rollback, security, attribution, and financial evidence remain incomplete. Preserve the proposed SEO, performance, accessibility, conversion, attribution, and repository concepts as deferred backlog only.

Continue only existing source-dated measurement, attribution reconciliation, failed-work repair-or-close review, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence. Do not treat missing telemetry as zero, assign aggregate commission to a site, claim ROI or causal lift, or create duplicate evidence requests.

Maintain the private launch gate. Continue internal evidence and unsent draft preparation only; no public exposure, rights-dependent monetization, alert expansion, deployment, configuration or credential change, dependency addition, spending, or external outreach is authorized until the existing legal, privacy, accuracy, security, attribution, measurement, and owner gates are complete.
